name: Elmore's Task
summary: Smith Argus sends you from Goldshire to Stormwind to help Grimand Elmore. The dwarven weaponsmith needs help with a delivery bound for his kin in Khaz Modan, and Argus trusts you to make the journey.

sections.title: A Word from the Forge
sections.body: In Goldshire, blacksmith Smith Argus watches for travelers he can trust with work beyond clearing wolves and kobolds. Grimand Elmore, a skilled dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, has asked for help with a delivery to his kin in Khaz Modan. Argus sees you as fit for the journey and sends you toward the city gates to answer Elmore's call.

sections.title: The Ties That Bind
sections.body: Stormwind and Ironforge depend on open trade and goodwill to keep both realms supplied and united. Argus says Elwynn Forest needs defenders, but honoring promises to the dwarves matters too. In northeastern Stormwind, the Dwarven District leads you to Elmore's shop, where a journey beyond the forest begins.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Elmore's Task?
aliases: where do i get elmore's task
faq.answer: Smith Argus, the blacksmith in Goldshire, sends you to help Grimand Elmore.

faq.q: Where can Grimand Elmore be found?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore works in a weapon shop in the northeastern Dwarven District of Stormwind.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this task?
faq.answer: Argus sends you to Elmore, who needs a trustworthy courier to carry a delivery north to his homeland. The journey takes you beyond Elwynn and through Alliance lands.
Speaking with Grimand Elmore completes the errand and opens Stormpike's Delivery, which asks you to carry his shipment north to Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why does Smith Argus care about dwarven deliveries?
faq.answer: Argus says strong trade ties with the dwarves of Khaz Modan help protect Stormwind and keep its supplies moving, even as Elwynn needs defenders.

faq.q: Do you need to be a blacksmith to take this quest?
faq.answer: No. Any Alliance traveler ready to go to Stormwind can take the delivery, whether or not they know blacksmithing.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help keep trade and trust strong between Stormwind and the dwarven clans of Khaz Modan.
As a dwarf, you may recognize how human smiths honor Ironforge's craft and help send supplies north to the mountains.
As a blacksmith, you see two smiths joined by their craft: Smith Argus in Goldshire and Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.
